title: A Salt section's editor fields, defined once for both platforms
description:
One file per section in contract/fields/<section id>.json, plus contract/fields/_section-settings.json for the wrapper settings every section carries. Salt for Next.js generates Payload fields from these files and Salt for WordPress generates ACF fields from them (SC-003: names, types, choices, limits and descriptions must match). Neither platform is the reference (SC-001): where they disagreed, each file records the canonical definition and, under platforms.<platform>, what that platform called it before and what it owes.

FIELD TYPES are limited to what both Payload and ACF Pro can express, and the list is closed: a type outside it is refused. text (Payload text; ACF text, or url when format is url). textarea. rich-text (Payload Lexical; ACF wysiwyg), with an allowed list of element kinds. image (Payload upload; ACF image, or gallery when many). link (a fixed shape: label, type internal|external, document, url, newTab; Payload group; ACF group or link). select (Payload select or radio; ACF select, radio or button_group: the widget is admin presentation and stays native). boolean (Payload checkbox; ACF true_false). number. list (Payload array; ACF repeater). group (both group). relationship (Payload relationship; ACF relationship or post_object) to a source id from contract/sections.json. collection-query (the shared 'pick items from a source' control, below).

NAMES are canonical ids, camelCase ASCII, unique among siblings, and stable: renaming one is a MAJOR (RELEASE-POLICY.md section 2). Option values are lower-case kebab ids. Empty-string option values are not allowed; a 'nothing chosen' choice gets a word (auto, focal-point, default).

CONDITIONS show a field only when a SIBLING field (same object: section, row or group) equals a value, is one of several values, or is filled (filled: true) or empty (filled: false) (SC-006). equals and in name only a select or a boolean; filled may name a sibling of any type but group, list, collection-query and link (an ACF group on WordPress), which ACF conditional logic cannot target; the gate enforces this, as a schema cannot see a sibling's type. An array of clauses means all must hold. No other expression form exists: no paths, no parent or root data. Where a platform used one, the field carries no condition, its description says when it applies, and the platform's note records the dropped condition.

SHARED SETTINGS. Every section file names the shared wrapper settings in 'shared'; they live in contract/fields/_section-settings.json and are stored in a group named 'settings' on each section. A section may change a shared field's default ('defaults') or leave a shared field out ('omit'). The settings file itself has section id 'section-settings' and must not carry 'shared' (the if/then at the end of this schema); no section in contract/sections.json may take that id.

COLLECTION-QUERY stores one object of this fixed shape. mode: automatic (the collection's usual order) | by-category | manual; default automatic. categories: terms from the source's own category taxonomy, many, shown when mode is by-category, and only offered for a source that has categories. items: hand-picked items of the source, many, in the order picked, shown when mode is manual. order: default (the collection's usual order) | newest | title (A to Z), shown unless mode is manual. count: whole number from 0 to 'max' (default 24), 0 meaning the section's default for that source, shown unless mode is manual. 'source' fixes the source; 'sourceField' names a sibling select whose value picks it.

GATE JOBS JSON Schema cannot do here, for a later script: sibling names unique; a condition's field names an existing sibling; a select default is one of its options; rowLabel names a child field; every source id exists in contract/sections.json; every variant in sections.json appears as a select with the same values; a filled clause names no group, list, collection-query or link.

section.description: The section id from contract/sections.json, or 'section-settings' for the shared wrapper settings file.

shared.description: The shared settings this section carries, stored in a group named 'settings'.

defaults.description: Shared field name to this section's default for it.

omit.description: Shared fields this section does not carry.

name.description: A canonical field name: camelCase ASCII. Stable; renaming is a MAJOR.

value.description: A stored option value: a lower-case kebab id, digits allowed.

source.description: A source id from contract/sections.json that holds items (not 'inline').

field.description: A sibling field's name. Paths are not names, so a parent's or another row's field cannot be reached.

filled.description: true: the sibling has a value (a non-empty text, textarea or rich text, a chosen image, option or relationship, a ticked boolean or any number; a group, list, collection-query or link cannot be tested, which the gate enforces). false: it has none. A clause tests filled or compares a value, never both.

condition.description: Show this field only when a sibling equals a value, is one of several values, or is filled or empty. An array means every clause must hold.

formerly.description: The field name or path this platform used before the contract; several when fields fold into one.

values.description: Former stored value to the contract's: flat, or keyed by a part of a composite field (a collection-query's mode, for example).

owes.description: What this platform must add or change to conform.

description.description: Editor help text, the same on both platforms.

format.description: url: an absolute address (http, https, mailto or tel), ACF url on WordPress. anchor: slugified on save to lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens (Latin diacritics folded by NFKD; any other run of characters, underscores and other scripts included, becomes one hyphen), so it never contains __, and an empty slug is no anchor; only the slug is stored. At render every anchor that is no landmark id and no repeat keeps its id; then a landmark clash becomes <anchor>-section and a repeat takes -2, -3, each skipping any id an editor set anywhere on the page; ids the system draws are <owner>__<part> and never meet one (markup/section#anchors, SC-012).

allowed.description: The element kinds an editor may use; both platforms strip anything else. Links allow http, https, mailto and tel.

many.description: An ordered set of images (Payload upload hasMany; ACF gallery).

withLabel.description: Whether the link carries its own visible text. Default true.

optionsFrom.description: icons: the options are the contract's content icon names (contract/sections.json, icons.content), plus any a site adds. A default must be one of the contract's.

rowLabel.description: The child field whose value names each row in the editor; for a link child, its label.

itemLabel.description: What one row is called, singular.

sourceField.description: A sibling select whose value is the source id.

modes.description: The modes offered, when not all three.

max.description: The highest count an editor may set. Default 24.
